unsupported: Deformable bodies, mesh assets, arbitrary MJCF, fluid/thermal/electrical dynamics and user code are unsupported.
Contacts and joint limits are compliant MuJoCo constraints, not rigid safety guarantees.

proposal.action_authorship: All plan action arguments supplied by plan author. Backend only schedules, validates and derives existing datums/proxies/revisions/native representations.

assumptions: OFFLINE_PROTOCOL_FIXTURE: explicit developer mass and constant motor assumptions from immutable Phase18D oracle; not model reasoning.
assembly_plan.explanation: DETERMINISTIC OFFLINE TEST ORACLE, NOT LIVE AI. Existing typed batches are deliberately used only to exercise plan validation, reconstruction, review and native verification.
assembly_plan.goal:
Create a simple four-wheel toy rover with a rectangular chassis, two horizontal axles, four wheels and two rear motor mounting plates.

Keep all mechanical components correctly connected.

Use simple dimensions suitable for a small desktop robot and prepare the assembly for physical simulation.
limitations: No steering, suspension, continuous wheel rotation, wiring/MCU execution, robust locomotion or hardware safety.

steps.purpose: Explicit independent free-root toy rover chassis; no controller/electrical binding
Reviewed front nominal solid axle and rotated chassis datum
Reviewed front_left_wheel; actual local +Z hinge, nominal axle/bore clearance, solid wheel contact proxy
Reviewed front_right_wheel; actual local +Z hinge, nominal axle/bore clearance, solid wheel contact proxy
Reviewed rear nominal solid axle and rotated chassis datum
Reviewed rear_left_wheel; actual local +Z hinge, nominal axle/bore clearance, solid wheel contact proxy
Reviewed rear_right_wheel; actual local +Z hinge, nominal axle/bore clearance, solid wheel contact proxy
Reviewed drive-motor mounting plate; motor hardware and powertrain not inferred
Reviewed drive-motor mounting plate; motor hardware and powertrain not inferred
